p140149344.desc:
This 3-bedroom apartment for rent in Marina Terrace, Dubai Marina, offers a practical layout with a downtown city and marina outlook. The home is fully furnished, featuring a bright living area, multiple bathrooms, and a U-shaped kitchen with integrated appliances, suitable for residents seeking an efficient and comfortable setup.
Key Features:
Balcony or terrace
Marina and skyline views
Furnished interiors
U-shaped kitchen layout
Built-in wardrobes
En-suite primary bedroom
Double-sink primary bathroom
Tiled flooring
Living room TV setup
3 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms
The living room includes large floor-to-ceiling windows with access to the balcony, allowing natural light and city views. Bedrooms feature storage beds, built-in wardrobes, tiled floors, and neutral finishes. The kitchen provides black granite countertops, light wood cabinets, an integrated oven with hood, microwave, double sink, and under-counter washing machine. The primary bathroom has a built-in bathtub, double-sink vanity, and coordinated tiling for a clean, functional design.
The balcony offers a high-floor position with city and marina views, glass-and-metal railing, and tiled flooring, providing an outdoor seating area to enjoy the surrounding skyline. Corridors and rooms are designed with practical circulation space and built-in storage. Light fixtures, curtains, and basic furnishings in the bedrooms support a simple, ready-to-use living environment.
Marina Terrace is a residential tower in Dubai Marina with an outdoor swimming pool, sun deck, and barbeque event space near the pool area. Residents have access to a well-equipped gymnasium, health clubs, Jacuzzi, sauna, steam rooms, and a tennis court, as well as dedicated children’s entertainment spaces. The tower offers 24-hour concierge service, supporting daily needs and visitor management.
